capability: Charity verification and continuous eligibility monitoring (API + evidence record)
buyer: Sponsors without in-house DD; grant processors; wealth platforms; donor apps
problem: Eligibility at approval and release; continuous monitoring vs 180-day manual re-verification (~$69 vs ~$1/acct-yr in prior model); church/Pub 78 gaps
demand_evidence: Paid market exists: CAF America $875,665 for GS CGF grant admin; Candid APIs $2,750-9,900; Charity Navigator paid API plans; iPhi resells GuideStar search API; Pledge free API with 5% donate fee
price_benchmarks: Data APIs $2.75k-$50k/month (conflicting); DD outsourcing ~$1,200/account at GS CGF; per-check pricing not public
build_basis: Unbound UNB-CHAR (42 clauses) + replay screening code exists (not production); sanctions recall 88/100 must be fixed
shared_components_with_unbound: UNB-CHAR, UNB-GRANT eligibility, sanctions screening, evidence store
contribution_to_full_platform: High: same engine is the core of the servicer
disconnected_product_risk: Low if built as the platform's own eligibility service; medium if a separate data product with its own data licences (Candid licence terms limit redistribution)
validates: Service quality (false-clear rate, latency); productivity (exceptions per 1,000 grants)
verdict: Build first as internal component; sell externally only after recall >=99% on sanctions replay and a licence-clean data stack

capability: Grant processing and disbursement (EFT-first, positive pay, returns handling)
buyer: Small/mid sponsors and CFs; foundations; processors
problem: Check-heavy payment, voids/reissues, remittance to charities
demand_evidence: Paid: Benevity $46-54M (AOGF), CyberGrants $5.4-8.3M (CAF America); Chariot Disbursements charges grantmakers per transaction; DAFpay 2.9%
price_benchmarks: ~0.7%-2.9% of grant dollars for processors; $25/wire at NCF
build_basis: Payments + bank integration + money-transmission analysis; counsel question unresolved in prior study
disconnected_product_risk: High: standalone disbursement makes the company a payments firm (licensing, bonding, fraud liability) before it is a servicer
validates: Economics of pass-through rails; service quality (time to charity)
verdict: Do not sell standalone; keep as pass-through via licensed processor inside the servicer

buyer: Sponsors with in-house ledgers; CFs on Blackbaud/Foundant
demand_evidence: No paid DAF-specific standalone product found; repo model warns base-case savings small and not to build standalone before observed baseline
price_benchmarks: None DAF-specific found; generic fintech recon SaaS prices not in repo
build_basis: Unbound UNB-RCN 97 clauses: large spec surface
contribution_to_full_platform: High: the accounting core is the hardest shared component
disconnected_product_risk: High: reconciliation without owning the ledger means many source formats and no control over breaks
validates: Productivity (break rate, close days) - the most important unmeasured economic driver
verdict: Build only as part of the ledger; offer 'close-as-a-service' to servicer clients

capability: Sponsor/board reporting (delegated-approval reports, Schedule D support, KPIs)
problem: Board oversight of delegated approvals; 990 Schedule D preparation
demand_evidence: No observed paid product; CF Insights survey benchmarking exists (price not found)
build_basis: Report templates over platform data; Folio has no renderer yet
disconnected_product_risk: Medium: reports from other vendors' data need integration per vendor

capability: Operational intelligence / benchmarking (cost per grant, exception rates, vendor footprint)
problem: No analyst coverage; vendor claims hard to check
demand_evidence: Hypothesis OF3/OF7: institutional tier $5-25k; Cerulli reports $21.5-22k; McKinsey $11.8M at Fidelity proves budget not scope
shared_components_with_unbound: None of the ledger; 990 harvest tooling
disconnected_product_risk: Medium: independence conflict if the same firm sells servicing
validates: Market evidence; buyer conversations (cheap demand test)

capability: Customer-service automation (donor/adviser contact deflection, status, statements)
buyer: Sponsors and vendors with service desks

price_benchmarks: No DAF-specific price; generic CX tooling
build_basis: Needs account data access, identity, audit trail
disconnected_product_risk: High: an AI agent on someone else's ledger without authoritative state gives wrong answers and creates liability

disconnected_product_risk: Medium: feeds from other sponsors require their consent and APIs

contribution_to_full_platform: High: every servicer onboarding needs it
disconnected_product_risk: Low: the importer is the onboarding tool
verdict: Build early; sell as onboarding + independent assurance
